exposure: Term multiparas with one fetus in a cephalic position and at least one previous cesarean delivery (Robson group 5)
Nulliparous term singleton vertex deliveries (Robson group 1 and 2)
cohort: All women who gave birth at three university hospital labor units in the Slovak Republic in 2017 (n=3361, 2795, and 2080 at each center)
finding: Analysis of cesarean delivery rates using the Robson classification identified Robson groups 1, 2, and 5 as the most modifiable groups for potentially reducing cesarean delivery rates.
mod_finding: The study found high rates of cesarean delivery in nulliparous women and women with previous cesarean deliveries, highlighting potential areas for reducing cesarean rates.
